notes.title: PIXEL PIXIE EA Beta V.2.1.2 LIVE! (Patch)
notes.content:
[h1]BETA Version 2.1.2 fixes deployed![/h1][p][/p][p]After much additional playtesting by myself and a handful of kind volunteers, I have deployed various fixes for the Beta version. If you wish to play the Beta version, please follow the instructions below.[/p][p][/p][p][u]*WARNING*[/u][/p][p][u]As the Beta version MAY still contain some serious bugs, I would strongly recommend backing up your save file located here:[/u][/p][p][u]C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Pixel Pixie\\www\\save[/u][/p][p][u]This way, if you encounter any major issues, you will not lose your hard earned save data![/u][/p][p][/p][p]In order to opt into the beta:[/p][p]1)  RIGHT CLICK Pixel Pixie in your Steam library[/p][p]2) Click PROPERTIES[/p][p]3) Click BETAS[/p][p]4) Under the BETA PARTICIPATION dropdown, select "playtest_beta"[/p][p]5) No password is required[/p][p][/p][p]After exiting, Steam should start downloading the Beta version! [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Patch Notes[/u][/h2][p][/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Major Bugs[/u][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]"Vampire event was bugged and 2/3s of the time would instead trigger the "Vagabond" event.[/p][/*][*][p]Specific scenario would allow you to replay event related to Valkyrie indefinitely, allowing infinite buff loop. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][u]Minor Bugs[/u][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Resolved issue where Monk description displayed too long when triggered in Monastery event.[/p][/*][*][p]Issue where you would select to skip dialogue between Monks but it would still play.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed some inconsistencies with "? Event intros" where they would display text in the center of the screen but others at the bottom.[/p][/*][*][p]Nurmi "bust pic" would stay on screen after the event at the end of Dark Shard run 4.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected issue with "Vampire" event sprite[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected issue with no Background displaying during "Bouncer Fight" event[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed issue with being able to interact with Casino clerk from weird angles.[/p][/*][*][p]Issue with background when interacting with special dungeon boss event resolved.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2][u]Balance Changes[/u][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Tree/Tree Kid boss BUFFED - Photosynthesis attack will increase mob ATK POW by 1 every time in addition to healing. (Boss has longevity but woeful damage output. Hope is to slightly tweak that by increasing as the battle goes on. 1 ATK per cast may be inconsequential though.)[/p][/*][*][p]Sungoyle Boss HP BUFFED from 4000 to 6500
[/p][/*][/list][h2][u]Quality of Life Changes
[/u][/h2][list][*][p]Certain event requires you to have "two sword fighters" in your party and ALSO happen upon the Arena event. Now, arena event will trigger if you have both party members to make this event less infrequent.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified dog event in volcano to make it less morbid. [/p][/*][*][p]Slowed down text during special events related to Reaper and Vorpal Knight fights. [/p][/*][*][p]"Light Puzzle" now flashes and stays resolved once player resolves (before would allow player to press button again and "un-resolve" the puzzle)[/p][/*][*][p]Various typo fixes and changes related to displaying Pixie art while they talk.[/p][/*][*][p]Amount of DARK SHARDS help will now be displayed when selecting what Difficulty you select at the start of a run.[/p][/*][*][p]Made "by PlayGG Doctor" logo smaller.[/p][/*][*][p]Moved "Hardcore/Casual Mode" Crystal to a more secluded part of the Temple of Progression.[/p][/*][*][p]Made certain secret events more obvious using "!" Icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Can now skip Sage dialogue on subsequent playthroughs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all again for your patronage and kind feedback. With a little more playtesting to hunt down any remaining pesky bugs, I will be comfortable making this "Beta" version the default version of Pixel Pixie. See y'all on the next update![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: PIXEL PIXIE EA Beta V.2.1.1 LIVE! (Patch)
notes.content:
[h1]BETA Version 2.1.1 fixes deployed![/h1][p][/p][p]After much additional playtesting by myself and a handful of kind volunteers, I have deployed various fixes for the Beta version. If you wish to play the Beta version, please follow the instructions below.[/p][p][/p][p][u]*WARNING*[/u][/p][p][u]As the Beta version MAY still contain some serious bugs, I would strongly recommend backing up your save file located here:[/u][/p][p][u]C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Pixel Pixie\\www\\save[/u][/p][p][u]This way, if you encounter any major issues, you will not lose your hard earned save data![/u][/p][p][/p][p]In order to opt into the beta:[/p][p]1)  RIGHT CLICK Pixel Pixie in your Steam library[/p][p]2) Click PROPERTIES[/p][p]3) Click BETAS[/p][p]4) Under the BETA PARTICIPATION dropdown, select "playtest_beta"[/p][p]5) No password is required[/p][p][/p][p]After exiting, Steam should start downloading the Beta version! [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Patch Notes[/u][/h2][p][/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Major Bugs[/u][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Addressed issue where Volcano Area bosses would not spawn again if you failed to defeat them on the first attempt.[/p][/*][*][p]A certain interaction involving a "quiz" could be skipped even if you had never seen it. [/p][/*][*][p]Unlockable upgrade that SHOULD have allowed you to start new runs with 5 items was only awarding you 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Game would freeze when trying to leave the "casino event" and then changing your mind.[/p][/*][*][p]Game would freeze if you made a certain choice regarding the "Griffin" and then re-entered the Meadow on a subsequent run.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][u]Minor Bugs[/u][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Addressed many typo and text consistency issues.[/p][/*][*][p]A certain furry character's portrait did not display during dialogue.[/p][/*][*][p]Wrong bust image was appearing when talking to Lampo (Red Pixie)[/p][/*][*][p]Relic shop would offer Light Curtain in exchange for grapes instead of money. Corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]Meadow "? event" could in one specific scenario, cause the available recruit to re-roll. [/p][/*][*][p]"Starting Gift" upgrade was not correctly displaying current Grapes held.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][u]Balance Changes[/u][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p]Griffin Boss HP/ATK reduced from 900/50 to 700/30.[/p][/*][*][p]Skill Tree upgrades that allow chance for recruits to act twice in one turn cost increased from 10 grapes to 15.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][u]Quality of Life Changes
[/u][/h2][list][*][p]"Monk" interaction now has dedicated music.[/p][/*][*][p]Events surrounding the "Mystic Hollow" location are now skippable if you have experienced them previously.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor adjustments to interactions with animals.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all again for your patronage and kind feedback. With a little more playtesting to hunt down any remaining pesky bugs, I will be comfortable making this "Beta" version the default version of Pixel Pixie. See y'all on the next update![/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: PIXEL PIXIE EA Beta V.2.0.0 LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]BETA Version 2.0.0 ready for playtesting![/h1][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your unlimited patience, as I have toiled to get this next update ready. It needs more playtesting so I have published it as a BETA.[/p][p][/p][p][u]*WARNING*[/u][/p][p][u]As the Beta version MAY still contain some serious bugs, I would strongly recommend backing up your save file located here:[/u][/p][p][u]C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Steam\\steamapps\\common\\Pixel Pixie\\www\\save[/u][/p][p][u]This way, if you encounter any major issues, you will not lose your hard earned save data![/u][/p][p][/p][p]In order to opt into the beta:[/p][p]1)  RIGHT CLICK Pixel Pixie in your Steam library[/p][p]2) Click PROPERTIES[/p][p]3) Click BETAS[/p][p]4) Under the BETA PARTICIPATION dropdown, select "playtest_beta"[/p][p]5) No password is required[/p][p][/p][p]After exiting, Steam should start downloading the Beta version! [/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]Patch Notes[/u][/h2][p][/p][p][/p][h2][u]New Content
[/u][/h2][p]-        Events that used to employ text and AI images are now fully playable and do not contain any AI                 images. This will impact at least 7 events.[/p][p]-        Complete rework of starting area (Meadow). Instead of being static and replayable every run, it can           be completed ONLY ONCE, after which, it will only offer some minor bonuses to the plater all                    subsequent runs. Decision in the Meadow area will also have slight impact on subsequent Meadow           bonuses.[/p][p]-        New “bust” art for all pixies and the Vorpal Knight.[/p][p]-        New BOOSTER PACK system. Some characters and event must now be unlocked. Shop in Starting              Town(ia) will allow players to spend new currency obtained in several new events for this purpose.[/p][p]-        New Clubhouse area displays all characters you have (and haven’t) encountered.[/p][p]-        Many new character interactions. Won’t spoil them 😉[/p][p]-        Various new events. Won’t spoil them either 😉[/p][p]-        Added visuals to various events such as “Monks” interaction.[/p][p]-        New Cat and Dog interactions in town.[/p][p]-        New “Casino” event[/p][p]-        New “Light Puzzle” event[/p][p]-        2 new achievements[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Bug Fixes[/u][/h2][p]-        Copious typos and text formatting issues. Fixes to art and text on character cards.[/p][p]-        Some items such as signs, chests and sconces can now only be examined from the front.[/p][p]-        Fixed issue where if character died in tutorial, their graphic persisted as a coffin in the Temple of                Progression.[/p][p]-        Critical hit rate will now increase by 1% per 1 “Crit Hit Rate” as intended. (was previously bugged                and odds remained low regardless of stat)[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Balance Changes
[/u][/h2][p]-        Enemies generally have more HP now.[/p][p]-        \[NERF] Gunslinger will now lose 1 Attack Power stat every time she attacks. This will force players              to use her sparingly or find a way to neutralize this downside by continuously increasing her attack           or finding a new artifact that prevents the loss [i]HINT[/i]![/p][p]-        Volcano area now causes damage to player as they walk around.[/p][p]-        Pixies now all offer both PHYS and MAG attack blessings.[/p][p]-        \[BUFF]Pixie’s Max HP buff increased from 10% to 15%[/p][p]-        \[NERF]Pendant Relic Max HP increase reduced from 50 to 35.[/p][p]-        \[NERF]IRON and PSI Monk attack power reduced from 120 to 100 and 90 respectively.[/p][p]-        Reduced money dropped by Meadow enemies.[/p][p]-        \[NERF]Regen relics power reduced from 5/10/20% per turn to 4/8/12% per turn.[/p][p]-        “?” events will now sometimes trigger a random battle.[/p][p]-        Merchant “?” event that would trigger a battle will now select enemies based on the biome you are in.[/p][p] [/p][p] [/p][h2][u]Quality of life Changes
[/u][/h2][p]-        HP bars are now RED. No longer orange which some people have VERY strong feelings about.[/p][p]-        Critical hits will now display text saying “CRIT”.[/p][p]-        Many events will now be abridged when encountered more than once in the same run.[/p][p]-        Many events will allow you to SKIP them if encountered previously.[/p][p]-        Title Screen now includes clearer instructions on using FULL SCREEN.[/p][p]-        Title Screen now has links to DISCORD and to EMAIL developer with anu suggestions.[/p][p]-        Improved item usage experience (Star Bag, for instance, says how many Star Bits you have just by             hovering over it. Tents, for instance, no longer require you to choose a party member but rather,               are used when chosen.)[/p][p]-        Removed many unused files, further reducing game size.[/p][p]-        Reduced overall swearing.[/p][p]-        More consistent Auto-Save functionality.[/p][p]-        New “splash screen” art with custom (and in my opinion, cuter) art.[/p][p]-        Improved art for the paths on both the world map and the skill tree screens.[/p][p]-        Per popular demand, “area name” now continuously displays on top left instead of just for a few                seconds.[/p][p]-        To avoid some playing for nearly 2 hours without ever seeing the Temple of Progression skill tree,             the opening tutorial will require players to explore the skill tree.[/p][p]-        Bazaars now only have 1 path to leave from.[/p][p]-        Some events that were based completely on randomness will now appear more consistently if you             have not seen them before and are progressing through the higher shard difficulties.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45117868/1284fc199c548e11d316504fcc0e755aea3c0559.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: EA ver. 1.1.3 is now LIVE
notes.content: Another very minor bug fix. Under extremely specific circumstances, a special message appears when abandoning a run. An error would occur where the game tried to access a specific sound file that was not available, resulting in an on-screen error message and a glitch with the audio that would persist temporarily. This should now be resolved.

notes.title: EA ver. 1.1.2 is now LIVE
notes.content: - Very minor patch that fixes a typo in the Collector's Clubhouse for the First Aid Kit +

notes.title: EA version 1.1.1 is now LIVE!
notes.content:
So many thanks to the enthusiastic early adopters that have played Pixel Pixie and been gracious enough to provide feedback over on the Discord Server! Bugs are my highest priority, so I am aiming to resolve them the same day they are reported. Here are a few other bugs that should now be resolved:

- Corrected typo in starting town from "communa" to "communal".
- Standardized character name for "Poison Oaky" character from the "Arena Event".
- Collector's Clubhouse will now acknowledge when the player has purchased a Ribbon from the store. Previously, it would continue to suggest player never obtained one.
- Gloom Knight and Enchantress will now correctly display, and CEASE to display the "Gloom Orb" status icon when they are buffed by it. Previously, it persisted between runs for the Gloom Knight and never showed up at all for the Enchantress (buff was being applied, just no visual indicator).
- MAJOR BUG: Player could participate in an event at the arena which required them to use only one party member, but at a specific interval during the event, they had a chance to open the formation menu and add in other characters to the party. This option will no longer be available.

Thank you for the support and ongoing feedback! I am collecting suggestions for new features and changes that I look forward to implementing, but for now, will continue to prioritize addressing "bugs and typos" in these regular patches. 


Happy gaming!

PlayGG.Doctor

notes.title: EA Version 1.1 - LIVE
notes.content:
Quick patch fix to address a few bugs pointed out by players. The following issues should now be resolved:

- Oasis bouncer asked for $300 but dialogue choices said you had to pay "$500". Updated so text also reads $500.
- Corrected typo that said "fee gift" to "free gift" related to unlocking free bonus gift at the start of runs.
- Corrected error where after unlocking a bonus 15% chance for extra physical attacks, text said you unlocked +2 Phys Damage. Now correctly indicates it is an increase to extra attack chance %.

notes.title: Early Access Launch
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone![/b]


[b]Pixel Pixie[/b] is now available and in Early Access. 


[u]What does this mean?[/u]


It means all feedback is welcome! Are there quality-of-life features you would like to see implemented? Are some areas or enemies too hard or too easy? Are there classes or items you believe need to be hit by the mighty nerf hammer, or perhaps have a buff bestowed upon them? Let me know! My goal is to create an enjoyable and balanced game.


[u]What kinds of new content do you want to see?[/u]


New areas? More random events? More playable classes? Character and plot expansion? Different modes outside of the standard main quest?

I would love to hear what you want to see added to or modified in Pixel Pixie.

And needless to say, if any BUGS or performance issues are discovered, please let me know—they will be my top priority!

Please consider joining the [url=https://discord.gg/QQNY5437]Pixel Pixie Discord Server[/url] or feedback can be sent directly to PlayGG.Doctor@gmail.com


While [b]Pixel Pixie[/b] is a "complete game" with a full campaign, over 30 classes to experiment with, and considerable post-game content, my goal is to continue improving the experience with the help of this community. Thank you all for your support!


Sincerely,

[i][b]PlayGG.Doctor[/b][/i]
